follow-up time: Third to twelfth weeks of life
cohort: Premature infants residing in a neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The gut microbiota of premature infants progresses through a choreographed succession of bacterial classes, influenced by factors like antibiotics and mode of birth.
mod_finding: Vaginal vs. Caesarian birth influence the pace, but not the sequence, of gut microbiota progression.
